description: This file defines a class 'Amortization' in the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing static methods for financial depreciation calculations such as AMORDEGRC and AMORLINC, with associated validation and date handling.

classes.name: Amortization
classes.description: Provides static methods for calculating various types of depreciation and amortization relevant to financial accounting within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: AMORDEGRC
methods.description: Calculates the depreciation for each period based on the French amortization system, adjusting for mid-period asset purchases and applying a depreciation coefficient depending on asset life.

methods.name: AMORLINC
methods.description: Calculates the period depreciation for an asset, considering partial periods and leap year adjustments, suitable for the French accounting system.

methods.name: getAmortizationCoefficient
methods.description: Determines the depreciation coefficient based on the asset's useful life, affecting the rate in AMORDEGRC.
